name: The Sociopaths
caption: The reigning WHCW North American Tag Team Champions, beaten down backstage before losing the titles to the returning Ultranationalists.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

identity.note: A common tag-team name already used by two other wings' own units; nothing links this record to either beyond the name.

name: The Ultranationalists
caption: Returned in disguise as “Los Diablos Extranjeros” to win the WHCW North American Tag Team Championship from the Sociopaths.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

notes: Previously lost a four-team elimination match for the titles against the Sociopaths, the Studs, and the team of Speed Racer and Super Dragon, per the promotion's own commentary.

name: Shock Therapy
caption: Faced the Thespian Express in an Anything Goes match that was thrown out after officials stormed the ring.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

identity.note: A common tag-team name already used by another wing's own unit; nothing links this record to it beyond the name.

name: The Thespian Express
caption: Former world tag team champions who dominated Shock Therapy in an Anything Goes match that ended with no decision.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

name: Strike Force
caption: Colossus's stable, ambushed by “the FOUR” in an unsanctioned construction-site brawl that ended with two of its own members turning on the rest.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

identity.note: A common stable name already used by two other wings' own units; nothing links this record to either beyond the name.

name: The FOUR
caption: Doomsday's stable, brought into the WHCW for an unsanctioned four-on-four construction-site brawl against Strike Force.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

notes: A fourth member was teased on the promotion's own broadcast graphics but never named in this record.

name: The Lords of the Ring
caption: A faction built around Adonis Mercury and Thunderstorm, drawing crowds and controversy amid a promotion-wide contract dispute.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Rumble in the Bronx 2 broadcast

notes: Adonis Mercury's own interview names Doomsday and Bane alongside himself in one answer, but the promotion's own broadcast graphics list Doomsday and Bane with a separate faction (“the FOUR”); the wider membership of the Lords is not resolved in this record.
